document_metadata.document_type: Mainframe To PySpark Target Design Specification

source_system_summary.processing_description: Batch COBOL application suite: CBACT01C reads account records and writes multiple output file formats; CBACT02C reads and prints card data; CBACT04C computes monthly interest charges based on transaction category balances and updates account balances.

mainframe_to_pyspark_mapping.source_reference: ACCTFILE-FILE (CBACT01C, CBACT04C), CARDFILE-FILE (CBACT02C), TCATBAL-FILE (CBACT04C), XREF-FILE (CBACT04C), DISCGRP-FILE (CBACT04C)
mainframe_to_pyspark_mapping.conversion_pattern: spark.read.parquet() filtered by key; or load from Delta/Iceberg table

mainframe_to_pyspark_mapping.source_reference: CVACT01Y (Account), CVACT02Y (Card), CVTRA01Y (Trans Category Balance), CVTRA02Y (Disclosure Group), CVACT03Y (Card Cross-Ref), CVTRA05Y (Transaction)
CBACT04C sequential read of TCATBAL-FILE by TRANCAT-ACCT-ID for group boundary detection
CBACT01C: PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' loop; CBACT02C: PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y' loop; CBACT04C: PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
mainframe_to_pyspark_mapping.conversion_pattern: DataFrame iterator or grouped processing with window functions

mainframe_to_pyspark_mapping.source_reference: READ ACCTFILE-FILE, READ CARDFILE-FILE, READ TCATBAL-FILE
WRITE OUT-REC, WRITE ARRY-REC, WRITE VBR-REC, WRITE TRANSACT-REC
CBACT01C: IF ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT EQUAL TO ZERO; CBACT04C: IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
CBACT04C: READ XREF-FILE, READ DISCGRP-FILE using keys
CBACT01C: ARR-ACCT-BAL OCCURS 5 TIMES with ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL and ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
CBACT01C: CALL 'COBDATFT' USING CODATECN-REC; CBACT01C/02C/04C: CALL 'CEE3ABD'
mainframe_to_pyspark_mapping.conversion_pattern: spark.udf.register() or pandas_udf for date/error handling
Separate PySpark job stage or DAG task

schema_elements.note: Type 1: 12-byte record (ACCT_ID + ACTIVE_STATUS); Type 2: 39-byte record (ACCT_ID + CURR_BAL + CREDIT_LIMIT + REISSUE_YYYY)
Type 2 record only - extracted from reissue date
Fixed value 'System' for generated interest transactions

join_specifications.business_purpose: Retrieve account group ID and current balance for interest rate lookup and balance update
Retrieve card number for transaction record population
Lookup applicable interest rate for transaction category balance

transformation_specifications.source_logic: IF ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT EQUAL TO ZERO THEN MOVE 2525.00 TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT ENDIF
MOVE ACCT-REISSUE-DATE TO CODATECN-INP-DATE WITH TYPE='2' AND OUTTYPE='2'; CALL 'COBDATFT'; MOVE CODATECN-0UT-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE
transformation_specifications.pyspark_logic: to_date(substring(col('ACCT_REISSUE_DATE'), 1, 10), 'yyyy-MM-dd').cast('string').regexp_replace('-', '') or UDF call to date format conversion

transformation_specifications.source_logic: MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(1); MOVE 1005.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(1); MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(2); MOVE 1525.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(2); MOVE -1025.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-BAL(3); MOVE -2500.00 TO ARR-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT(3)
transformation_specifications.pyspark_logic: array(struct(col('ACCT_CURR_BAL'), lit(1005.00)), struct(col('ACCT_CURR_BAL'), lit(1525.00)), struct(lit(-1025.00), lit(-2500.00)))

transformation_specifications.source_logic: MOVE ACCT-ID TO VB1-ACCT-ID; MOVE ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS TO VB1-ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS; SET RECORD LENGTH TO 12
transformation_specifications.pyspark_logic: struct(col('ACCT_ID'), col('ACCT_ACTIVE_STATUS')) for Type 1 variable-length record

transformation_specifications.source_logic: MOVE ACCT-ID TO VB2-ACCT-ID; MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO VB2-ACCT-CURR-BAL; MOVE ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT TO VB2-ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT; MOVE WS-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY TO VB2-ACCT-REISSUE-YYYY; SET RECORD LENGTH TO 39
transformation_specifications.pyspark_logic: struct(col('ACCT_ID'), col('ACCT_CURR_BAL'), col('ACCT_CREDIT_LIMIT'), substring(col('ACCT_REISSUE_DATE'), 1, 4)) for Type 2 variable-length record

transformation_specifications.source_logic: ADD 1 TO WS-TRANID-SUFFIX; STRING PARM-DATE WS-TRANID-SUFFIX DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO TRAN-ID
ADD WS-TOTAL-INT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL; MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT; MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Account File Sequential Read Until EOF - Read all account records from ACCTFILE sequentially until end-of-file condition
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'; IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-ACCTFILE-GET-NEXT
business_rule_mappings.pyspark_logic: for row in df.collect(): process_row(row); or df.foreach(lambda row: process_row(row))
business_rule_mappings.source_reference: CBACT01C PROCEDURE DIVISION main loop; BRE BR001

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Account Read Status Routing - Evaluate file status after READ: '00' continue, '10' EOF terminate, other error abend
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '00' MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE IF ACCTFILE-STATUS = '10' MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT ELSE MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT; IF APPL-EOF MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE ELSE IF NOT APPL-AOK DISPLAY ERROR; PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM
business_rule_mappings.pyspark_logic: try: rows = df.collect() except: log_error(); raise Exception(); handle_eof() if rows_count == 0
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: Exception handling with try/catch or DataFrame isEmpty() check

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Default Current Cycle Debit Value - When ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT is zero, assign 2525.00 to output
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: IF ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT EQUAL TO ZERO MOVE 2525.00 TO OUT-ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Account Reissue Date Format Conversion - Convert YYYY-MM-DD to YYYYMMDD via COBDATFT assembler routine
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: MOVE ACCT-REISSUE-DATE TO CODATECN-INP-DATE; MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-TYPE; MOVE '2' TO CODATECN-OUTTYPE; CALL 'COBDATFT' USING CODATECN-REC; MOVE CODATECN-0UT-DATE TO OUT-ACCT-REISSUE-DATE
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: String manipulation with regexp_replace or UDF

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Variable-Length Record Type 1 - Write 12-byte record with Account ID and Active Status
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: MOVE 12 TO WS-RECD-LEN; MOVE VBRC-REC1 TO VBR-REC(1:WS-RECD-LEN); WRITE VBR-REC
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: Select specific columns and write as separate record type

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Variable-Length Record Type 2 - Write 39-byte record with Account ID, Balance, Credit Limit, Reissue Year
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: MOVE 39 TO WS-RECD-LEN; MOVE VBRC-REC2 TO VBR-REC(1:WS-RECD-LEN); WRITE VBR-REC
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: Select specific columns with derived field (substring) and write

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Array Record Hardcoded Balance/Debit Values - Populate array with mixed live and hardcoded values
business_rule_mappings.pyspark_logic: array(struct(col('ACCT_CURR_BAL'), lit(1005.00)), struct(col('ACCT_CURR_BAL'), lit(1525.00)), struct(lit(-1025.00), lit(-2500.00)))
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: Array of structs with mixed literal and column values

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Card File Sequential Read Loop - Read all card records from CARDFILE until EOF
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'; IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' PERFORM 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT; IF END-OF-FILE = 'N' DISPLAY CARD-RECORD
business_rule_mappings.pyspark_logic: for row in df.collect(): print(row); or df.foreach(lambda row: display(row))

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Interest Rate Lookup by Account Group and Transaction Category - Composite key lookup
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID + TRANCAT-TYPE-CD + TRANCAT-CD to composite key; READ DISCGRP-FILE USING composite key
business_rule_mappings.pyspark_logic: df.join(discgrp_df, on=[col('ACCT_GROUP_ID') == col('DIS_ACCT_GROUP_ID'), col('TRANCAT_TYPE_CD') == col('DIS_TRAN_TYPE_CD'), col('TRANCAT_CD') == col('DIS_TRAN_CAT_CD')], how='left')
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: Multi-key join or composite key lookup

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Default Interest Rate Fallback - On lookup not found, retry with 'DEFAULT' group code
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: IF DISCGRP-STATUS = '23' MOVE 'DEFAULT' TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID; PERFORM 1200-A-GET-DEFAULT-INT-RATE
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: when/otherwise with fallback UDF or secondary join

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Skip Interest Calculation When Rate is Zero - No interest/fees computed for zero-rate categories
business_rule_mappings.source_reference: CBACT04C PROCEDURE DIVISION main loop; BRE BR003 (CBACT04C)

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Monthly Interest Calculation Formula - (Balance * Annual Rate) / 1200
Accumulate Total Interest Per Account - Sum all category interest into account total
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT TO WS-TOTAL-INT (for each category); MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT (on account boundary)

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Interest Transaction Record Generation - Write system-generated interest transaction
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: MOVE '01' TO TRAN-TYPE-CD; MOVE '05' TO TRAN-CAT-CD; MOVE 'System' TO TRAN-SOURCE; STRING 'Int. for a/c ' ACCT-ID INTO TRAN-DESC; MOVE WS-MONTHLY-INT TO TRAN-AMT; MOVE XREF-CARD-NUM TO TRAN-CARD-NUM; WRITE FD-TRANFILE-REC
business_rule_mappings.pyspark_logic: df.withColumn('TRAN_TYPE_CD', lit('01')).withColumn('TRAN_CAT_CD', lit('05')).withColumn('TRAN_SOURCE', lit('System')).withColumn('TRAN_DESC', concat(lit('Int. for a/c '), col('ACCT_ID'))).withColumn('TRAN_AMT', col('WS_MONTHLY_INT')).withColumn('TRAN_CARD_NUM', col('XREF_CARD_NUM'))
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: withColumn() for each field mapping with literals and concat()

business_rule_mappings.business_description: Account Balance Update with Total Interest and Cycle Reset - Update account balance and reset cycles
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: ADD WS-TOTAL-INT TO ACCT-CURR-BAL; MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT; MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT; REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM ACCOUNT-RECORD
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: withColumn() for arithmetic and literal reset; write/merge for update

business_rule_mappings.business_description: First Account Boundary Suppression - Skip account update for very first boundary in run
business_rule_mappings.source_logic: IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y' PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT ELSE MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
business_rule_mappings.conversion_pattern: Row numbering with window function to skip first account
business_rule_mappings.source_reference: CBACT04C PROCEDURE DIVISION main loop; BRE BR009 (CBACT04C)

try: card_df = spark.read.parquet('path'); assert card_df.count() > 0 except Exception: abend()

aggregation_specifications.aggregation_logic: Sum of monthly interest amounts across all transaction categories for an account

Date format conversion via external assembler call (COBDATFT)
Hardcoded array values mixing live data with constants
File status error handling with detailed routing
Window-based account boundary and transaction ID generation
